bash: # Check the ensurepip bundled wheel to confirm it contains the pip module
python3 -c "
import zipfile, os
w = '/usr/local/lib/python3.13/ensurepip/_bundled/pip-24.3.1-py3-none-any.whl'
with zipfile.ZipFile(w) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    pip_files = [n for n in names if n.startswith('pip/') and n.endswith('.py')]
    print(f'Total files in wheel: {len(names)}')
    print(f'pip .py files: {len(pip_files)}')
    print(f'Sample: {pip_files[:5]}')
"
